ModMetaData.name: HugsLib - 1.7 Waylith Fix (Continued)
ModMetaData.author: UnlimitedHugs
ModMetaData.description:
HugsLib is a shared library required by many RimWorld mods.
This continued edition keeps the original HugsLib package ID so dependent mods can detect it. It includes a dedicated RimWorld 1.7 Waylith fix: opening or publishing the log now falls back to Logs/Player.log when the former root-level Player.log path does not exist.
Version: 12.0.0 + RimWorld 1.7 compatibility patch.
HugsLib 是许多 RimWorld Mod 使用的共享前置库。
本续作版保留原 HugsLib 包 ID，以保证其他 Mod 能正确识别依赖；同时加入独立的 RimWorld 1.7 Waylith 修复。当旧版根目录 Player.log 不存在时，打开或发布日志会自动使用 Logs/Player.log。
请勿与原版 HugsLib 同时启用。
